blocks.text: A custom view is a saved search criterion that you often reuse and require for your daily operations. You can use it as a rule to trigger a policy. To learn more, see 3rd-Party App Governance Policies. On the Inventory page, you can easily create, access, and edit a custom view.
To create a new custom view:

blocks.item: Click Inventory in the left-side navigation.
On the Inventory page, add conditions by clicking relevant filters and selecting desired values. Click +More to add additional filters.
To save the custom view, click the Save icon located next to the search bar.

In the Save View window, enter the custom view name and click Save As. You can also mark the view as a favorite for easier access (this creates a shortcut to the view under Reports > Predefined Reports in the left-side navigation).

blocks.text: If you changed the global platform filters, a confirmation window appears asking whether you want to update the saved view to include your current tenant selection. Click Confirm to proceed.

blocks.item: Click Inventory in the left-side navigation.
On the Inventory page, click My views and choose the desired custom view.

blocks.text: To edit an existing custom view:

blocks.item: Change filters by adding, removing, or adjusting existing ones.

blocks.text: A confirmation window appears stating that the view already exists.

blocks.item: Click Save & Replace if you want to edit and overwrite it.

blocks.text: If this view is already used as a trigger (rule) for a policy, the confirmation window highlights that, so you might take it under advisement before editing such a view.
